findings.summary: The player fell four times on the opening ledge jumps, mainly on the long jump to the small platform before the entrance, and questioned whether the jump was possible at all.

quotes.text: Come on, that's way too far.

evidence.visual: The player runs along the narrow green floating path and repeatedly falls into the sky while trying to jump across to the next small green platform, respawns, and tries the same gap again.

findings.suggested_fix: Move the small green landing platform under the brown entrance about one platform-width closer to the take-off edge and widen it by one tile, so a normal running jump lands with margin instead of needing a near-perfect jump.

findings.summary: The objective says "Reach the beacon" but no beacon is visible in the plaza, so the player wandered in circles for about 40 seconds before noticing steps on a side wall.

quotes.text: I'm just going in circles here.

telemetry: objective_update at 30.9 s text="Reach the beacon."
evidence.visual: The player enters a sandy plaza with tall brown pillars and crates and walks loops around them, passing the same crates and pillars several times. No beacon or marker is visible on screen before the player eventually finds green-topped steps on a side wall and climbs them.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a tall bright cyan beam of light and a bouncing marker above the green steps on the plaza wall in view from the plaza entrance, so the destination named by "Reach the beacon" can be seen over the pillars.

findings.summary: In the hall the player did not know how to open the closed gate and only noticed the small red button on the raised platform after about 23 seconds of trying the gate and wandering.

quotes.text: Is that a button up there?

telemetry: objective_update at 70.9 s text="Find a way through."
objective_update at 100.1 s text="The gate is open. Find the exit."
evidence.visual: The player loops around the grey checkered room, walks into the closed wooden gate in the wall, circles the crates, and only later climbs a crate to reach the raised orange platform holding the small red button.

findings.suggested_fix: Make the button twice as large, give it a pulsing glow, and put a matching red sign with an arrow on the closed gate pointing toward the raised platform, so the player links the button to the gate.

findings.summary: An enemy waiting at the drop landing killed the player twice almost as soon as they landed, before they could see it or react.

quotes.text: What? I couldn't even see it.
That's not fair. It gets you the second you land.

evidence.visual: The player drops through a narrow brown corridor into a green room where the small red-and-white mushroom enemy is right by the landing area. The player dies twice shortly after landing before getting past it on the third entry.

findings.suggested_fix: Move the mushroom enemy's starting position at least five tiles away from the drop landing square and keep it still for two seconds after the player lands, so the player can see it before it can kill them.

findings.summary: The EXIT sign at the fork points left, but the left route is a dead end, forcing the player to backtrack to the fork and take the other route.

quotes.text: Exit sign points left. Okay. Okay.
Dead end but the sign said exit.

evidence.visual: The player reaches a green hedge fork with a white EXIT sign and red arrow pointing left, follows the left corridor to a blocked dead end, then turns around and walks back past the sign to the fork.

findings.suggested_fix: Re-point the red EXIT arrow at the fork away from the left dead end and toward the opening that leads to the corridor, so the sign matches the real exit route.

findings.summary: The final corridor is one long straight walk with nothing to do or decide for about 40 seconds, and the player commented twice that it was still going before the flag appeared.

evidence.visual: The player walks straight for about 40 seconds down a narrow green hedge corridor, passing repeated identical grey pillars with no turns, enemies, or other decisions, until a red flag appears at the far end.

findings.suggested_fix: Shorten the corridor by removing the middle half of its repeating pillar sections, cutting the straight walk from about 40 seconds to about 20 seconds.
